about: Context sentences for your own words that are not Verb lab verbs, in the lab's shape: v is the word, alt other ways you may have saved it, [form] marks it in fr. Case, accents and a leading article are ignored when matching.

words.hook: false friend: not a delay, the time allowed
words.fr: Le [délai] pour s'inscrire est de deux semaines.
words.en: The deadline to sign up is two weeks.
words.also: dans les délais = on time; a delay = un retard

words.hook: la marge = the margin, room on the page
words.fr: Avec ce budget, on n'a aucune [marge de manœuvre].
words.en: With this budget we have no room to manoeuvre.

words.hook: lâcher = let go of, la prise = the grip
words.fr: Il faut apprendre à [lâcher prise] et arrêter de tout contrôler.
words.en: You have to learn to let go and stop controlling everything.

words.hook: être censé + inf = to be supposed to
words.fr: Tu étais [censé] m'appeler hier !
words.en: You were supposed to call me yesterday!

words.hook: le sein = the bosom: in the heart of a group
words.fr: Il y a des désaccords [au sein de] l'équipe.
words.en: There are disagreements within the team.
words.also: au sein du gouvernement = within the government

words.hook: il y a belle lurette = ages ago, always with il y a
words.fr: Il y a [belle lurette] que je ne l'ai pas vu.
words.en: I haven't seen him in ages.

words.hook: ouf = fou backwards (verlan): pas fou = not great
words.fr: Franchement, le film était [pas ouf].
words.en: Honestly, the film wasn't great.
words.also: c'est ouf ! = it's crazy!

words.hook: papier + -asse (the ending that makes it pejorative)
words.fr: La [paperasse] pour le visa m'a pris des semaines.
words.en: The paperwork for the visa took me weeks.

words.hook: what an arnaqueur (con man) does to you
words.fr: Vingt euros pour un café ? C'est une [arnaque] !
words.en: Twenty euros for a coffee? It's a rip-off!
words.also: arnaquer qqn = to rip someone off

words.fr: [En matière de] sécurité, l'entreprise est très stricte.
words.en: When it comes to safety, the company is very strict.

words.fr: [Du fait de] la grève, tous les trains sont annulés.
words.en: Because of the strike, all trains are cancelled.
words.also: du fait que + verb = because

words.hook: in a theatre, the wings where the sets slide (coulisser)
words.fr: Le documentaire montre les [coulisses] du festival.
words.en: The documentary shows the festival behind the scenes.
words.also: en coulisses = behind the scenes

words.hook: le plomb = the fuse: blow a fuse
words.fr: Après trois heures d'attente, il a [pété les plombs].
words.en: After three hours of waiting, he lost it.
words.also: péter un câble = the same

words.hook: ça n'empêche pas que: still, all the same
words.fr: Tu as peut-être raison. [N'empêche que] c'est injuste.
words.en: You may be right. All the same, it's unfair.

words.hook: déborder = to overflow: too much work spilling over
words.fr: Je suis [débordé] cette semaine, on se voit lundi ?
words.en: I'm swamped this week, shall we meet on Monday?

words.hook: une émeute = a riot; un émeutier = a rioter
words.fr: Des [émeutes] ont éclaté après le match.
words.en: Riots broke out after the match.

words.fr: Il y a un [désaccord] entre les deux ministres.
words.en: There is a disagreement between the two ministers.
words.also: être en désaccord avec qqn = to disagree with someone

words.hook: not revenge here: on the other hand
words.fr: Le loyer est cher ; [en revanche], le quartier est très calme.
words.en: The rent is expensive; on the other hand, the area is very quiet.

words.fr: C'est un sujet [épineux], évitons-le au dîner.
words.en: It's a thorny subject, let's avoid it at dinner.

words.hook: larguer les amarres = cast off: left behind on the quay
words.fr: Je n'ai rien compris au cours, je suis complètement [largué].
words.en: I understood nothing in class, I'm completely lost.
words.also: larguer qqn = to dump someone

words.hook: as if struck by a star (sidéral)
words.fr: J'étais [sidéré] par sa réponse.
words.en: I was stunned by his answer.

words.fr: Conduire après avoir bu, c'est complètement [inconscient].
words.en: Driving after drinking is completely reckless.
words.also: also unconscious: il est resté inconscient = he stayed unconscious

words.hook: atrocious, and in daily speech just awful
words.fr: J'ai eu un mal de tête [atroce] toute la nuit.
words.en: I had an awful headache all night.

words.fr: Ce qu'il a dit sur elle est [ignoble].
words.en: What he said about her is vile.

words.hook: fuir = to flee, and also to leak
words.fr: Il y a une [fuite] d'eau sous l'évier.
words.en: There's a water leak under the sink.
words.also: prendre la fuite = to run away

words.fr: J'ai oublié le gâteau au four, il est [cramé].
words.en: I forgot the cake in the oven, it's burnt.

words.hook: se mettre à qqch, and y stands for the task: get down to it
words.fr: Demain, je [m'y mets] sérieusement.
words.en: Tomorrow I'm getting down to it seriously.

words.hook: le pli = the fold, a crease that stays
words.fr: Au début, me lever tôt était dur, mais j'ai [pris le pli].
words.en: At first getting up early was hard, but I've got into the habit.

words.fr: [Au bout de] dix minutes, il est parti.
words.en: After ten minutes, he left.
words.also: au bout de la rue = at the end of the street

words.fr: Les habitants sont [indignés] par la hausse des loyers.
words.en: Residents are outraged by the rise in rents.

words.fr: Les critiques sont [mitigées] : certains adorent, d'autres non.
words.en: The reviews are mixed: some love it, others don't.

words.fr: Sa réponse m'a laissé [perplexe].
words.en: His answer left me puzzled.

words.hook: en garde = on guard: put someone on guard
words.fr: Le médecin l'a [mis en garde] contre le sucre.
words.en: The doctor warned him about sugar.
words.also: mettre qqn en garde contre qqch

words.fr: Cette étude [remet en question] tout ce qu'on croyait savoir.
words.en: This study calls into question everything we thought we knew.
words.also: se remettre en question = to question oneself

words.hook: admittedly: concede, then a mais follows
words.fr: [Certes], c'est cher, mais la qualité est là.
words.en: Admittedly, it's expensive, but the quality is there.

words.hook: not gold here: now, yet, the fact that turns the argument
words.fr: Il dit qu'il était chez lui. [Or], ses voisins l'ont vu sortir.
words.en: He says he was at home. Yet his neighbours saw him go out.

words.fr: Son avis est plus [nuancé] que ça.
words.en: His opinion is more nuanced than that.

words.fr: Le projet est risqué ; [néanmoins], il mérite d'être tenté.
words.en: The project is risky; nevertheless, it's worth trying.

words.hook: plaider = what a lawyer does in court
words.fr: L'association [plaide pour] plus de pistes cyclables.
words.en: The association argues for more cycle lanes.
words.also: plaider coupable = to plead guilty

words.fr: Après l'arnaque, il est devenu très [méfiant].
words.en: After the scam, he became very wary.

words.hook: and yet: the surprise after the fact
words.fr: Il a raté l'examen ; [pourtant], il avait beaucoup travaillé.
words.en: He failed the exam, and yet he had worked a lot.

words.fr: Il pleuvait, mais on est sortis [tout de même].
words.en: It was raining, but we went out all the same.

words.hook: while, whereas: two facts that clash
words.fr: Il joue aux jeux vidéo [alors qu']il a un examen demain.
words.en: He's playing video games when he has an exam tomorrow.

words.fr: Le médecin a été très [rassurant].
words.en: The doctor was very reassuring.

words.hook: un constat = a statement of fact (un constat d'accident)
words.fr: On [constate] une hausse des prix depuis janvier.
words.en: Prices have clearly risen since January.

words.fr: Les salariés [revendiquent] une hausse de salaire.
words.en: The employees are demanding a pay rise.
words.also: revendiquer un attentat = to claim an attack

words.hook: virer = to turn, so turn someone out
words.fr: Il s'est fait [virer] après deux semaines.
words.en: He got fired after two weeks.
words.also: un virement = a bank transfer

words.fr: Le voleur [s'est enfui] par la fenêtre.
words.en: The thief ran away through the window.

words.fr: Tu as bien travaillé, tu [mérites] des vacances.
words.en: You worked hard, you deserve a holiday.
words.also: ça vaut la peine = it's worth it

words.fr: Le blessé [gémissait] de douleur.
words.en: The injured man was groaning in pain.

words.hook: the water flows, the boat goes under
words.fr: Le bateau a [coulé] en quelques minutes.
words.en: The boat sank in a few minutes.
words.also: l'eau coule = the water runs

words.hook: aspire to; un aspirateur sucks things in
words.fr: Elle [aspire à] une vie plus calme.
words.en: She longs for a calmer life.

words.fr: Ne lui dis pas ça, tu vas le [vexer].
words.en: Don't say that to him, you'll offend him.
words.also: se vexer = to take offence

words.hook: saoul = drunk: makes your head spin
words.fr: Arrête de parler de ton boulot, tu me [saoules] !
words.en: Stop going on about your job, you're wearing me out!

words.fr: Les escrocs l'ont [piégé] avec un faux site.
words.en: The scammers trapped him with a fake website.

words.hook: a flame or someone on their feet, about to go
words.fr: La flamme de la bougie [vacillait].
words.en: The candle flame was flickering.
words.also: vaciller = to sway, to wobble

words.fr: Mon patron me [flique] toute la journée.
words.en: My boss watches my every move all day.

words.hook: obéir à qqn: indirect, so je lui obéis
words.fr: Ce chien n'[obéit] à personne.
words.en: That dog obeys no one.

words.hook: to deplore: regret it in public
words.fr: Le maire [déplore] le manque de logements.
words.en: The mayor deplores the lack of housing.

words.fr: J'[estime] que c'est injuste.
words.en: I consider it unfair.
words.also: estimer qqn = to hold someone in esteem

words.hook: douter, made stronger: fear what is coming
words.fr: Elle [redoute] l'entretien de demain.
words.en: She dreads tomorrow's interview.

words.fr: Il [reconnaît] qu'il s'est trompé.
words.en: He admits he was wrong.

words.fr: [Sans déconner], tu as vraiment quitté ton boulot ?
words.en: No kidding, you really quit your job?
words.also: sans blague = the polite version

words.fr: Vous êtes d'accord ? [Tout à fait].
words.en: Do you agree? Absolutely.
words.also: pas tout à fait = not quite

words.hook: un fil = a thread: the path you follow
words.fr: Elle a choisi la [filière] scientifique au lycée.
words.en: She chose the science track in high school.
words.also: la filière automobile = the car industry

words.fr: Il y a deux heures d'[attente] aux urgences.
words.en: There's a two-hour wait at the ER.
words.also: répondre aux attentes = to meet expectations

words.hook: where you sit; where the company sits
words.fr: Le [siège] de l'entreprise est à Paris.
words.en: The company's head office is in Paris.
words.also: prenez un siège = take a seat

words.fr: Le [numérique] a changé notre façon de travailler.
words.en: Digital tech changed the way we work.
words.also: un appareil photo numérique = a digital camera

words.fr: Petit [aparté] : la réunion est décalée à 15 h.
words.en: Quick aside: the meeting is moved to 3 pm.
words.also: en aparté = privately

words.hook: = plus, more formal, after the verb
words.fr: Tu devrais dormir [davantage].
words.en: You should sleep more.
words.also: davantage de temps = more time

words.hook: saoul = drunk: so much of it you feel drunk
words.fr: Il me parle de son boulot depuis une heure, je suis [saoulé].
words.en: He's been talking about his job for an hour, I'm sick of it.
words.also: tu me saoules = you're getting on my nerves

words.fr: Le loyer [mensuel] est de 900 euros.
words.en: The monthly rent is 900 euros.
words.also: hebdomadaire = weekly, annuel = yearly

words.fr: Il est [pénible], il se plaint tout le temps.
words.en: He's annoying, he complains all the time.
words.also: un travail pénible = a tough job

words.fr: Au Japon, on mange beaucoup de poisson [cru].
words.en: In Japan, people eat a lot of raw fish.
words.also: cru is also the participle of croire: je l'ai cru

words.fr: Le service était [déplorable], on ne reviendra pas.
words.en: The service was awful, we won't come back.

words.fr: Tu as gagné ? T'as du [bol] !
words.en: You won? You're lucky!
words.also: un bol de café; ras-le-bol = fed up

words.hook: une foulée = a stride: in the same stride
words.fr: Il a eu son bac et, [dans la foulée], il est parti en Australie.
words.en: He passed his exams and, right after, left for Australia.

words.fr: L'affaire fait la [une] de tous les journaux.
words.en: The affair is on the front page of every paper.
words.also: à la une = in the headlines

words.fr: Sa plus grande [crainte], c'est de perdre son travail.
words.en: His biggest fear is losing his job.
words.also: de crainte de + inf = for fear of

words.fr: Ce film est vraiment [flippant].
words.en: This film is really creepy.
words.also: ça me fait flipper = it freaks me out

words.hook: soi + disant = saying it about itself
words.fr: Son [soi-disant] ami ne l'a jamais aidé.
words.en: His so-called friend never helped him.
words.also: il est soi-disant malade = he's supposedly sick

words.hook: une bulle de savon = a soap bubble
words.fr: La [bulle] immobilière va finir par éclater.
words.en: The housing bubble will burst eventually.
words.also: les bulles d'une BD = speech bubbles

words.fr: Il a gagné la [course] de vélo.
words.en: He won the bike race.
words.also: faire les courses = to do the shopping

words.fr: J'ai la [flemme] de cuisiner ce soir.
words.en: I can't be bothered to cook tonight.

words.fr: Je ne me sens pas à l'[aise] avec lui.
words.en: I don't feel comfortable with him.
words.also: mal à l'aise = uncomfortable

words.hook: un créneau = a slot (time or parking)
words.fr: Je déteste [faire un créneau] dans une rue étroite.
words.en: I hate parallel parking in a narrow street.
words.also: un créneau horaire = a time slot

words.hook: a blow straight to the heart
words.fr: Ce livre, c'est mon [coup de cœur] de l'année.
words.en: This book is my favourite of the year.
words.also: avoir un coup de cœur pour = to fall for (a place, a flat)

words.fr: Il ne reste jamais en place, il a la [bougeotte].
words.en: He never stays put, he has itchy feet.

words.fr: J'en ai [marre] de ce temps pourri.
words.en: I'm fed up with this rotten weather.

words.fr: Il est en deuxième année de [fac].
words.en: He's in his second year of uni.

words.fr: La [compétence] la plus importante, c'est la communication.
words.en: The most important skill is communication.

words.fr: Mets la [nappe], on mange dans cinq minutes.
words.en: Put the tablecloth on, we eat in five minutes.
words.also: une nappe phréatique = groundwater

words.fr: Elle est très [douée] en langues.
words.en: She's very gifted at languages.
words.also: doué pour + inf = good at

words.fr: « Il n'est pas très malin » : c'est une [litote].
words.en: 'He's not very smart': that's an understatement.

words.fr: Je lis un [polar] de Fred Vargas.
words.en: I'm reading a Fred Vargas crime novel.

words.fr: La rue est en [pente], fais attention à vélo.
words.en: The street slopes, be careful on the bike.
words.also: remonter la pente = to get back on one's feet

words.fr: [Et si] on allait au cinéma ce soir ?
words.en: What if we went to the cinema tonight?
words.also: et si tu essayais ? = why don't you try?

words.fr: Il a un humour très [fin].
words.en: He has a very subtle sense of humour.
words.also: une tranche fine = a thin slice

words.fr: Cet [appareil] ne marche plus.
words.en: This device doesn't work anymore.

words.fr: Il est [têtu] comme une mule.
words.en: He's as stubborn as a mule.

words.hook: la piste de ski, la piste de danse
words.fr: La police suit une nouvelle [piste].
words.en: The police are following a new lead.
words.also: la piste de danse = the dance floor

words.fr: Je suis encore [débutant] en guitare.
words.en: I'm still a beginner at guitar.

words.hook: en sorte = in such a way
words.fr: Je vais [faire en sorte que] tout soit prêt.
words.en: I'll make sure everything is ready.
words.also: + subjonctif

words.fr: Je suis [déchiré] entre deux offres.
words.en: I'm torn between two offers.

words.hook: le fond = the bottom: all the way down
words.fr: Il a mis la musique [à fond].
words.en: He turned the music up full blast.
words.also: étudier à fond = to study thoroughly

words.fr: Tu es parti avec eux ? [Traître] !
words.en: You left with them? Traitor!

words.fr: C'est une [atteinte] à la vie privée.
words.en: It's an invasion of privacy.
words.also: une atteinte à la liberté = an attack on freedom

words.fr: Mon fils est en dernière année de [primaire].
words.en: My son is in his last year of primary school.
words.also: le collège = middle school

words.fr: La photo n'est pas [nette].
words.en: The photo isn't sharp.
words.also: une baisse nette = a clear drop

words.fr: Mon grand-père travaillait à l'[usine].
words.en: My grandfather worked at the factory.

words.fr: Le commerce [illicite] de cigarettes explose.
words.en: The illegal cigarette trade is booming.

words.fr: Il regarde [constamment] son téléphone.
words.en: He's constantly looking at his phone.

words.hook: a spark that lights a fire
words.fr: Il manque l'[étincelle] entre eux.
words.en: The spark is missing between them.

words.fr: Ma fille entre en [maternelle] l'an prochain.
words.en: My daughter starts nursery school next year.

words.hook: hors de = outside of; le commun = the ordinary
words.fr: C'est une femme [hors du commun].
words.en: She's an extraordinary woman.

words.fr: Son [aveu] a surpris tout le monde.
words.en: His confession surprised everyone.
words.also: passer aux aveux = to confess (to the police)

words.hook: aller = to go: the way you go
words.fr: Il roulait à toute [allure].
words.en: He was driving at full speed.
words.also: avoir de l'allure = to look stylish

words.hook: arrière = back, le plan = the shot
words.fr: On entend un chien [en arrière-plan].
words.en: You can hear a dog in the background.

words.fr: Les [cotisations] sociales sont élevées en France.
words.en: Social security contributions are high in France.

words.fr: Son seul [défaut], c'est qu'il est toujours en retard.
words.en: His only flaw is that he's always late.
words.also: par défaut = by default

words.fr: À 25 ans, il est encore [puceau].
words.en: At 25 he's still a virgin.

words.fr: Un [incendie] a détruit la forêt.
words.en: A fire destroyed the forest.
words.also: un feu = a fire, un incendie = a blaze

words.fr: Beaucoup de jeunes vivent dans la [précarité].
words.en: Many young people live in insecurity.
words.also: un emploi précaire = an insecure job

words.fr: Le jury l'a déclaré [coupable].
words.en: The jury found him guilty.
words.also: se sentir coupable = to feel guilty

words.fr: « Amour » et « toujours », c'est une [rime] facile.
words.en: 'Amour' and 'toujours' is an easy rhyme.
words.also: ça ne rime à rien = it makes no sense

words.fr: On joue à un [jeu de société] ce soir ?
words.en: Shall we play a board game tonight?

words.fr: Ils ont acheté une [ferme] en Normandie.
words.en: They bought a farm in Normandy.
words.also: la ferme ! = shut up (slang)

words.fr: J'ai [pris goût] à la course à pied.
words.en: I've developed a taste for running.

words.fr: Il n'y a pas de [haine] dans ses paroles.
words.en: There's no hatred in his words.
words.also: La Haine = the 1995 film

words.fr: Je dois [faire le tri] dans mes vêtements.
words.en: I need to sort through my clothes.
words.also: le tri sélectif = recycling

words.fr: Passe-moi une [lingette], j'ai les mains sales.
words.en: Pass me a wipe, my hands are dirty.

words.hook: the past that weighs on you
words.fr: Ces deux-là ont un lourd [passif].
words.en: Those two have a heavy history.
words.also: la voix passive = the passive voice

words.fr: Il a reçu une [claque].
words.en: He got slapped.
words.also: j'en ai ma claque = I've had enough

words.hook: un fil = a thread: in one line
words.fr: Il a travaillé douze heures [d'affilée].
words.en: He worked twelve hours in a row.

words.fr: [Au fait], tu viens samedi ?
words.en: By the way, are you coming Saturday?

words.fr: Ajoute un peu de [bouillon] de légumes.
words.en: Add a bit of vegetable broth.

words.fr: On est arrivés à 8 heures [pile].
words.en: We arrived at 8 on the dot.
words.also: tomber pile = to come at the perfect time

words.fr: Ce film n'a pas pris une [ride].
words.en: This film hasn't aged a bit.

words.fr: Il est [aveugle] de naissance.
words.en: He's been blind since birth.
words.also: l'amour est aveugle

words.fr: C'est un fait [avéré].
words.en: It's a proven fact.
words.also: s'avérer = to turn out

words.fr: On a [convenu] d'un rendez-vous jeudi.
words.en: We agreed on a meeting Thursday.
words.also: ça me convient = it suits me

words.hook: un lot = a batch, a set
words.fr: Il a gagné le gros [lot].
words.en: He won the jackpot.
words.also: un lot de trois = a pack of three

words.fr: Elle travaille [à temps partiel].
words.en: She works part-time.
words.also: à plein temps = full-time

words.fr: [En somme], tout s'est bien passé.
words.en: All in all, everything went well.

words.fr: Les [vendanges] commencent en septembre.
words.en: The grape harvest starts in September.

words.fr: Il est très [habile] de ses mains.
words.en: He's very good with his hands.

words.fr: [Au fond de] moi, je savais qu'il avait raison.
words.en: Deep down, I knew he was right.
words.also: au fond = basically

words.fr: Le film est long. [Par ailleurs], la fin est décevante.
words.en: The film is long. Moreover, the ending is disappointing.
words.also: d'ailleurs = besides

words.fr: [Tout comme] son père, il est médecin.
words.en: Just like his father, he's a doctor.

words.hook: dé-goût = no taste left for it
words.fr: Il a raté le train de deux minutes, il est [dégoûté].
words.en: He missed the train by two minutes, he's gutted.
words.also: ça me dégoûte = it disgusts me

words.fr: [Tant que] tu es là, je n'ai pas peur.
words.en: As long as you're here, I'm not scared.

words.fr: Il y a une [fissure] dans le mur.
words.en: There's a crack in the wall.

words.fr: Le succès est allé [au-delà de] nos espérances.
words.en: The success went beyond our hopes.

words.fr: Quelle [garce], elle m'a menti !
words.en: What a bitch, she lied to me!

words.fr: Il est en [quête] de sens.
words.en: He's in search of meaning.

words.hook: bourrer = to stuff: stuffed with drink
words.fr: Il était complètement [bourré] hier soir.
words.en: He was completely drunk last night.
words.also: bourré de = packed with

words.fr: J'ai un [emploi du temps] chargé cette semaine.
words.en: I have a busy schedule this week.

words.fr: Je dois faire un [exposé] sur la Révolution.
words.en: I have to give a presentation on the Revolution.

words.fr: Prends un [cachet] pour ta migraine.
words.en: Take a pill for your migraine.
words.also: le cachet d'un artiste = an artist's fee

words.fr: Sa mort [subite] a choqué tout le monde.
words.en: His sudden death shocked everyone.

words.hook: se foutre de = to make fun of
words.fr: Dix euros le café ? [Tu te fous de moi] ?
words.en: Ten euros for a coffee? Are you kidding me?

words.fr: Jette l'[emballage] dans la poubelle jaune.
words.en: Throw the packaging in the yellow bin.

words.en: The authorities must act.

words.en: It's a totally crazy idea.

words.en: Call me as soon as you arrive.

words.en: Never again will I fly this airline.

words.en: I liked her right away.

words.fr: Il a gagné [haut la main].

words.fr: Le [locataire] paie 800 euros par mois.

words.hook: a bowl full to the brim

words.en: The young offender was released.

words.en: He lied with incredible nerve.

words.en: He's a top-level athlete.

words.fr: Mon [colocataire] ne fait jamais la vaisselle.

words.en: The rent goes up every year.

words.en: This car is very reliable.

words.fr: Tu es [passé à côté de] l'essentiel.

words.en: The weather is awful.

words.fr: C'est [dingue], on s'est rencontrés au même endroit !

words.en: Her son is blond and curly-haired.

words.fr: La sorcière lui a jeté un [sort].
words.en: The witch cast a spell on him.
words.also: le sort = fate

words.fr: L'[épreuve] écrite dure trois heures.
words.en: The written exam lasts three hours.
words.also: une épreuve = an ordeal

words.fr: Avec le [recul], je regrette.
words.en: In hindsight, I regret it.

words.fr: Il a un [TOC] : il vérifie dix fois la porte.
words.en: He has OCD: he checks the door ten times.

words.fr: Il y a une [lueur] d'espoir.
words.en: There's a glimmer of hope.

words.fr: J'ai trop de [taff] cette semaine.
words.en: I have too much work this week.

words.fr: Il y a trop de [pub] à la télé.
words.en: There are too many ads on TV.

words.hook: intervenir = to speak, to step in

words.en: The first speaker talks about AI.

words.fr: Pour réussir, il faut [avoir la niaque].
words.en: To succeed, you need drive.

words.fr: Le chien s'est blessé à la [patte].

words.fr: Il m'a appelé [en plein] milieu de la nuit.

words.fr: On ne connaît pas encore l'[ampleur] des dégâts.

words.fr: Les [frais] de livraison sont offerts.

words.en: She put a clip in her hair.

words.fr: Il est léger comme une [plume].

words.en: He's doing an IT training course.

words.en: This player is underrated.

words.fr: La Sécu [prend en charge] 70 % des frais.
words.en: Social security covers 70% of the costs.

words.fr: Parler anglais est un vrai [atout].

words.en: That jerk stole my spot!

words.fr: Une [tenue] correcte est exigée.
words.en: Proper dress is required.

words.en: He gets unemployment benefit.

words.fr: Le prix est [au-dessous] de 10 euros.
words.en: The price is below 10 euros.
words.also: en dessous = more common in speech

words.fr: [Faute de] temps, je n'ai pas pu venir.
words.en: For lack of time, I couldn't come.

words.fr: Tout le monde chante ses [louanges].
words.en: Everyone sings his praises.

words.fr: Lis bien la [consigne] avant de commencer.
words.en: Read the instructions carefully before you start.
words.also: la consigne = the left-luggage office, the bottle deposit

words.fr: Prends la [piste cyclable], c'est plus sûr.
words.en: Take the bike lane, it's safer.

words.fr: On se voit en [fin de semaine] ?
words.en: Shall we meet at the end of the week?
